The '''1932–33 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the fifth season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece.  It was held in two groups, the South and the North.

The South Group was formed by 5 teams which resulted as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian Association]]''': The 3 teams qualified in the [[1931–32 Panhellenic Championship|previous season]].
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus' Association]]''': The 2 teams qualified in the [[1931–32 Panhellenic Championship|previous season]].

The North Group was formed by 3 teams which resulted as follows:
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian Association]]''': The 3 teams qualified in the [[1931–32 Panhellenic Championship|previous season]].

These teams did not participate in the local championships and their stay in the national division was judged by ranking matches. Finally, the teams that participated in the final phase of the championship resulted as follows:
*'''South Group''': The first 2 teams of the ranking.
*'''North Group''': The winner.

[[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 2nd championship and their 1st undefeated. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] finished last and were relegated. However, in September 1933 the rules changed and with the abolition of the national category, Panathinaikos took place in the next season's national championship.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43502&seg=|title=Ψηφιακή Βιβλιοθήκη της Βουλης των Ελλήνων}}</ref>

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point'' - ''Loss: 0 points''.
